entities.summary: Thomas Dybdahl (b. 1979-04-12, Sandnes Municipality) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Sandnes Municipality and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
